_help: Events shown ONLY when the live backend is unavailable (the live events always win when it answers). Edit this file to add or change them. Each entry: id = a unique NEGATIVE whole number (-1, -2, ...). enabled = false hides an entry without deleting it (leave out to mean true); the sample below is disabled: copy it, change it and set "enabled": true. title is required. summary is one short line for cards; description is the longer text (blank lines make paragraphs). tags = short words. format = "ONLINE", "IN_PERSON" or "HYBRID"; IN_PERSON and HYBRID should have venueName and city (address and mapUrl optional); ONLINE may set onlineUrl to a public joining link, otherwise the page says the link is sent when people register. registrationUrl = where Register opens (leave "" for no Register button). priceType = "FREE" or "PAID"; priceLabel is the text shown for PAID, e.g. "IDR 150,000". poster = file name only of an image placed in public/events/ (see src/data/README.md); leave "" to use the default brand poster. timeZone is REQUIRED and must be an IANA name such as Asia/Jakarta (WIB), Asia/Makassar (WITA) or Asia/Jayapura (WIT), never an abbreviation or offset. sessions = one entry per date: date "YYYY-MM-DD", startTime and endTime 24h "HH:mm" on the event's own clock (timeZone), optional label such as "Day 1". cancelled = true marks a cancelled event. Whether an event is upcoming or past is worked out from today's date automatically.
